typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		INACTIVE_DATE as timestamp,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		ENTERED_USER as string,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		CLASSIFICATION as integer,
		COMMENTS as string,
		EXTERNAL_REF as string,
		LE_STATUS as string,
		PARENT_LE_ID as integer,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		HOLIDAYS as string,
		TRIPARTY_ALLOC_TYPE as integer,
		COUNTRY as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		ENTERED_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		INACTIVE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID as integer,
		ENTERED_USER as string,
		VERSION_NUM as integer,
		CLASSIFICATION as integer,
		COMMENTS as string,
		EXTERNAL_REF as string,
		LE_STATUS as string,
		PARENT_LE_ID as integer,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		HOLIDAYS as string,
		TRIPARTY_ALLOC_TYPE as integer,
		COUNTRY as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		ENTERED_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INACTIVE_DATE,
		LEGAL_ENTITY_ID,
		ENTERED_USER,
		VERSION_NUM,
		CLASSIFICATION,
		COMMENTS,
		EXTERNAL_REF,
		LE_STATUS,
		PARENT_LE_ID,
		SHORT_NAME,
		HOLIDAYS,
		TRIPARTY_ALLOC_TYPE,
		COUNTRY,
		LONG_NAME,
		ENTERED_DATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
